barRaise.topFinding: Compliance-data-steward is now the weakest dimension in the whole portfolio (score 22, down from 35): the exact live billing-bypass exploit detail for Chains and the credential-exposure language for the private Skylight status file, both flagged in the 2026-08-06 run, are still shipping unfixed in the public GitHub Pages artifact a week later, and this run independently reconfirmed the root cause from a second angle (security). This is also the first bar-raise to run the full 33-lens set (orchestration, release-pipeline, and public-voice domains joined static-site), and that new coverage surfaced the weakest cluster in the run: work-queue-hygiene (30), skill-chain-handoff-integrity (28), and scheduled-task-firing-state (35) all point at the same story, a work queue with 28 permanently-stuck promptless items and doubling pending depth, an audit-pointer handoff that is confirmed broken right now for YaE's own project, and a scheduled-task registry (.project-context.json) that names nine tasks which no longer exist under those names. Health drops from 70 to 64 and the verdict stays needs-attention. None of this is a hard-rule breach, but the live public exposure of another project's exploit detail is the one item that should not wait for the routine queue.

actions.title: Split public status-JSON summary from full bar-raise finding detail so Chains.json stops shipping exact billing-bypass file:line exploit detail in the public Pages artifact.
Move the hordes/ and brackish-rising/ gate check off a client-visible plaintext constant, or correct CLAUDE.md's claim the phrase never lives in this repo.
Exclude private:true status JSONs (Skylight) from the Pages artifact entirely instead of relying on an unlinked path.
Stop reusing one literal editor password across 10+ gated design pages; per-page phrases or a real auth mechanism.
Add required-field validation to the queue add path; promptless items doubled to 28 this run and sit permanently stuck.
Record measured token cost per scheduled run and set an explicit spend ceiling; usage.json is 9+ days stale with no cap defined anywhere. [CHRONIC x15]
Add an automated existence check for audit/barRaise latestReportPath after retention runs; YaE's own pointer is confirmed dangling 6 days stale right now.
Fold the audit-pointer refresh into the same step that runs report retention, or write both atomically, so the two cannot drift apart.
Add live:milestone markers to the 8 project pages still shipping hand-written milestone prose; Budget has disagreed with its own status JSON for 40+ days across 12 cycles.
Run git gc on the local YaE clone; 26,348 loose objects at 1.26 GiB, never packed, 4x past git's own auto-gc trigger. Severity raised from MED to HIGH this run.

Rewrite .project-context.json's scheduled_tasks to the live task registry; all 9 currently-listed names are retired or renamed, none exist under those names. Severity raised from MED to HIGH this run. [CHRONIC x16]
Size backlog-burndown capacity to the real arrival rate or reduce bar-raise fan-out; pending queue depth has roughly doubled in two weeks (374 to 762 of 903 items).
Add a concurrency test for queue-edit.ps1's lock acquisition; it has a documented history of corrupting the queue and zero automated test coverage.
Decide explicitly whether portfolio meta-tooling volume (88 status/ touches vs 2 index.html touches in a week) is this repo's intended long-term shape, or split it out now.
Promote one projects.json source of truth with per-surface visibility flags; extend parity to the GitHub repo description. [CHRONIC x16]
Add schemaVersion and a required-key assertion to check-status-json.ps1; reconcile Gnosis.json onto the shared shape. [CHRONIC x22]
Split a lean per-project usage summary out of the 600KB+ usage.json for the status page; reserve the full payload for the usage dashboard.
Move .work-queue.json toward an append/compact log format so a single write does not rewrite the whole ~1.9MB file.
Constrain the queue status field to an enum at both write paths. [CHRONIC x15]
Port the Budget and Scheduler project pages onto the current template. [CHRONIC x16]
Retire BAR_RAISE_ROADMAP.md as complete and delete BAR_RAISE_HANDOVER.md. [CHRONIC x22]
Add -Project/-Status/-Priority filters, and honor -Id, on the queue get/read path. [CHRONIC x15]
Reset the stuck GitHub Pages ACME authorization for yesandeverything.com before the next cert renewal window.
Route Apothecary's 3 statically-imported util modules (autofit.js, print.js, saved-labels.js) through the existing cache-bust scheme.
Decide whether /dashboard/ and /status/ are public, then make robots.txt and the homepage links agree.
Add a pack script that rebuilds packaged .skill artifacts from source on release, or delete the stale ones. [CHRONIC x15]
Pin the wrangler CLI version used for dashboard-api deploys and KV usage-pushes; stop swallowing KV-put failures.
Extend the gate-payload integrity guard to the Brackish Rising gate as well. [CHRONIC x16]
Dedupe duplicate archive ids; make the queue drop path archive rather than delete. [CHRONIC x15]
Reject or warn on a duplicate queue item id at add time.

Give a failed self-status write a durable record (or a client-visible writeFailed flag the dashboard's stale-detection can read) instead of console-only output; Discord notify is intentionally off for YaE.
Add a single aggregate endpoint (or build-time bundle) returning all project statuses in one response; request count currently scales 1:1 with portfolio size.

Enforce the openFindings-list contract (it was stored as a dict, not the spec'd list) and delete the matching openFindings entry in the same write that closes an action, so closed actions cannot orphan.
Fix the em dash in the queue-drain hourly commit-message template; it has shipped in 8.6% of the last 500 commits, all from one generated pattern.
Make release.ps1's -Path effectively mandatory (or diff against a pre-recorded snapshot); the unscoped-commit footgun the script's own comments warn about has bitten twice in the last week.
Surface a promptless-item count on the status dashboard or in queue-edit.ps1's get summary; the only way to notice the 28 stuck items today was a raw-JSON query.

Delete the queue-drain-hourly task entry or document in .project-context.json that its function moved to backlog-burndown-daily; it has been disabled 13 days and reads identically to a silent failure.
Verify queue-drain-hourly's Step 0 archive-prune actually runs; 71 completed items are sitting in the live queue in violation of its own spec.

Rewrite unstick-git.ps1 to dot-source git-guard.ps1 and call Assert-GitSafe instead of a raw Remove-Item on .git/index.lock; the blind delete is exactly what the documented safety rule next to it warns against.
Add —/–/entity-code dash patterns to HereBeHordes's check_gdd_voice.py and BrackishRising's check_voice.py; the exact blind spot already bit YaE once on 2026-08-02 and was fixed there only.
